[EN] This is the Abyss within you.
[ES] Este es el Abyss dentro de ti.

[EN]
This is where your personal demons dwell.
You must face your demons and overcome them. I'm afraid it won't be easy; these are the only enemies you've never been able to withstand.
Stay strong."I will."[Recall your greatest fear.]
[ES]
Aquí es donde habitan tus demonios personales.
Debes enfrentar a tus demonios y superarlos. Me temo que no será fácil; estos son los únicos enemigos a los que nunca has podido resistir.
Mantente fuerte."I will."[Recall your greatest fear.]
